# Client tests that start real threads: the loader's workers (`Loader::new`), the scene thread
# (`World::with_loader`), or a plain thread. Some of them wait on wall-clock time, so they do not
# gate merges (see docs/agents/ci.md).
#
# One test-name filter per line. libtest matches a filter anywhere in the full test name. The
# `linux` and `windows-tests` jobs `--skip` each line; the `real-thread-tests` job runs only these.
# Every client test therefore runs in exactly one of the two.
#
# A new test that starts a loader or the scene thread must be added here.

# Every test in bins/client/src/streaming_tests.rs (this includes its two ignored full-size tests).
streaming_tests::

# The tests in bins/client/src/loader.rs that call `new_loader`, which starts two workers. The
# other three tests there (queue order, job classes by order, workers_for) start none.
loader::tests::a_job_is_classed_by_who_wants_it_and_the_queue_follows_the_reach
loader::tests::a_job_that_only_the_lead_wants_is_prefetch_not_drawn
loader::tests::the_workers_go_no_further_ahead_than_what_the_frame_thread_has_taken_in
loader::tests::a_brick_wanted_newly_and_near_is_not_queued_behind_the_far_ones_asked_for_before
loader::tests::a_job_generates_only_the_children_that_can_be_drawn_and_counts_those
loader::tests::a_job_that_was_given_up_on_is_not_generated
loader::tests::a_late_drop_does_not_undo_a_brick_that_was_asked_for_again
loader::tests::a_worker_that_panics_panics_the_frame_thread_instead_of_loading_stopping_silently

# bins/client/src/priority.rs: spawns a thread to lower its priority (Linux only).
priority::tests::
